stories.name_fr: Croissance annuelle du BPA ajusté visée jusqu’en 2028
stories.explanation: Taux de croissance annuel composé du BPA ajusté, formulé « mid-teens » par la société.
stories.story_fr: CVS Health prévoit une croissance annuelle composée du BPA ajusté de type « mid-teens » jusqu’en 2028.
stories.story_en: CVS Health expects a mid-teens adjusted EPS CAGR through 2028.
stories.citation: CVS Health expects to achieve a mid-teens Adjusted EPS CAGR through 2028 driven by continued strong performance from its unique collection of businesses, underpinned by best-in-class innovation and technology.

stories.explanation: Connexions avec les consommateurs dans l’ensemble des activités.
stories.story_fr: CVS Health indique des connexions avec environ 185 M de consommateurs dans ses activités.
stories.story_en: CVS Health reports connections with approximately 185 million consumers across its businesses.
stories.citation: CVS Health has unmatched reach, with connections to approximately 185 million consumers across its businesses including over 9,000 pharmacies and through broad omnichannel capabilities.

stories.explanation: Réseau de pharmacies cité par la société.
stories.story_fr: CVS Health compte plus de 9 000 pharmacies.
stories.citation: CVS Health has unmatched reach, with connections to approximately 185 million consumers across its businesses including over 9,000 pharmacies and through broad omnichannel capabilities.

stories.name_fr: Américains à moins de 16 km d’une pharmacie CVS
stories.name_en: Americans within 10 miles of a CVS Pharmacy
stories.explanation: Part de la population vivant à moins de 10 miles (unité de la société).
stories.story_fr: CVS Health indique que 85 % des Américains vivent à moins de 10 miles d’une pharmacie CVS.
stories.story_en: CVS Health says 85% of Americans live within 10 miles of a CVS Pharmacy.
stories.citation: The Company builds engagement locally, with 85 percent of Americans living within 10 miles of a CVS Pharmacy.

stories.name_fr: Relations avec des prestataires de soins
stories.explanation: Relations avec des prestataires de soins, plus de 60 clients assureurs.
stories.story_fr: CVS Health compte 1,5 M de relations avec des prestataires de soins et plus de 60 clients assureurs.
stories.story_en: CVS Health has 1.5 million relationships with health care providers and more than 60 health plan clients.
stories.citation: In addition, the Company has 1.5 million relationships with health care providers and more than 60 health plan clients, allowing it to play a central role in health care and providing a unique opportunity to shape the future of health care.

positionnement_ia.detail: CVS Health construit une plateforme ouverte d’engagement des consommateurs conçue nativement avec l’IA, ancrée dans une application unique.
positionnement_ia.citation: CVS Health is building the platform as an artificial intelligence (“AI”)-native product.
